description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the AttrEval-Simulation, dividing it into six categories. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a different data source: ENTITYQUEST (blue, 26.0%), HOTPOTQA (red, 24.2%), POPQA (yellow, 21.6%), TRIVIAQA (orange, 22.7%), TREC (green, 1.9%), and WEBQUESTIO (teal, 3.6%). The percentage labels are shown next to each slice, outside the pie chart, and are connected to their respective slices with lines. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with ENTITYQUEST being the largest slice, followed by HOTPOTQA, TRIVIAQA, POPQA, WEBQUESTIO, and TREC. The chart does not include a legend, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
